title: Workforce
subtitle: Services that answer from your knowledge, for callers outside openKMS.
empty: No workforce agents yet. Create one to publish a knowledge base as a service.
cardCreateHint: Name it, then bind the knowledge it may answer from.
name: Name
descriptionPlaceholder: What this service is for, and who calls it.
instructionsPlaceholder: You answer staff questions about HR policy. Cite the clause you used.
instructionsHint: Copied into the session as AGENTS.md. Say what the agent is responsible for and what it must not do.
modelHint: Leave empty to use the deployment default.
skillsHint: What the agent may do besides reading. The three core skills are always available.
schemaLookup: Look up the model before querying
retrieveOnMiss: Only when the first pass misses
maxToolRoundsHint: Upper bound on tool calls in one turn. Empty means the agent's default.
workspaceHint: Let the agent keep files in the conversation's own folder.
sandboxHint: Runs commands in the conversation's folder. A guard rail, not a sandbox.
knowledgeLead: Which knowledge sources this agent may answer from. One question names one source.
noReadableKbs: You can read no knowledge bases yet.
dataLead: The Catalog models and ontology groups this agent may consult when it answers with numbers or objects.
modelBound: Consulting a model lets the agent run its metrics as evidence.
groupBound: Consulting a group lets the agent read those object types and links.
credentialCreatedBody: It is shown once. Only its hash is stored.
revokeConfirm: Revoke credential "{{name}}"? Any caller using it stops working.
archiveConfirm: Archive "{{name}}"? Its credentials stop working and it disappears from the list.
readOnlyNote: A credential may only read and ask — it can never change anything.
chatPickSourceLead: A conversation stays with one source. Pick the one to talk to {{name}} about.

profileLead: What the service is called, who it answers, and what it is told.
skillsLead: What the agent can do besides reading the corpus.
toolsLead: Where it answers from, what it may look up, and what it may run.
toolsEnvHint: Two capabilities that touch the session's own folder.
credentialsLead: Credentials belong to this agent alone; revoking one stops this service and leaves your own sign-in alone.
endpointHint: POST here with a credential from the list, naming one bound knowledge source.
behaviorLead: What counts as an acceptable answer, and how many steps it may take to get there.
temperatureHint: How varied the wording is. Empty uses the deployment's value (0.3).
thinkingHint: Some gateways expose a thinking budget; asking for it costs latency and tokens.
